title: A metric on solutions of the bargaining problem
abstract: arXiv:2610.32877v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider the classic bargaining problem: two players have to agree on a `fair' division $(x,y) \in \Omega \subset \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}^2$ which results in Player 1 receiving $x$ and Player 2 receiving $y$. The usual approach to this problem has been to impose a number of desirable axioms that a fair division should have and then conclude that the solution is uniquely defined by the axioms. We take an orthogonal view, avoid the discussion of axioms, and ask whether different and contradicting axioms may give rise to similar solutions. To this end, we define a natural metric on the space of solutions to the bargaining problem. The metric shows a strong internal consistency between the three celebrated solutions due to Nash (1950), Raiffa (1953) and Kalai-Smorodinsky (1975). It identifies problematic cases for the Utilitarian solution and the Perles-Maschler solution (1981). The area monotonic solution of Anbarci-Bigelow (1988) is shown t

translated_title: 讨价还价问题解空间上的一种度量
translated_abstract: 我们考虑经典的讨价还价问题：两个参与者必须就一个“公平”的分配 $(x,y) \in \Omega \subset \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}^2$ 达成一致，其中参与者1获得 $x$，参与者2获得 $y$。解决这一问题的传统方法是施加一系列公平分配应满足的合意公理，然后得出解由这些公理唯一确定的结论。我们采取一种正交的视角，避免对公理的讨论，转而追问：不同甚至相互矛盾的公理是否可能产生相似的解。为此，我们在讨价还价问题的解空间上定义了一个自然的度量。该度量显示了Nash（1950）、Raiffa（1953）和Kalai-Smorodinsky（1975）这三个著名解之间具有很强的内部一致性。它还识别出了功利主义解和Perles-Maschler解（1981）的问题案例。Anbarci-Bigelow（1988）的面积单调解被证明……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文在讨价还价问题的解空间上定义了一个自然度量，揭示了Nash、Raiffa和Kalai-Smorodinsky三个经典解之间具有很强的内部一致性，同时识别出了功利主义解和Perles-Maschler解的问题案例。
en_tdlr: The paper defines a natural metric on the space of solutions to the bargaining problem, revealing strong internal consistency among the Nash, Raiffa, and Kalai-Smorodinsky solutions while identifying problematic cases for the Utilitarian and Perles-Maschler solutions.
